raw: See, Liz? I told you I'd find it.
actually: Liz, I found it as promised.

raw: So, can we get dinner now?

actually: The villagers seem to have been correct.

raw: This creature is clearly not of this world.
actually: This creature appears to come from another world.

raw: Because I'm hearing the same noises from my stomach.
actually: My stomach makes the same sounds.

raw: Still, this looks like the beast the locals told me about.
actually: It resembles the creature the locals described.

raw: Now, I know the shot's blurry, but that's the best we got.
actually: This blurry photograph is the best available.

raw: No one's wanted to get close to whatever that is.
actually: No one has wanted to approach it.

raw: Is there anything that you can tell me about this creature?
actually: What can you tell me about it?

raw: Well, when it first showed up, our animals started disappearing.
actually: Our animals began disappearing after it arrived.

raw: Soon after, even the game in the woods was gone.
actually: Wild animals in the woods soon disappeared too.

raw: Now, no one wants to leave their house.
actually: People are now afraid to leave home.

raw: The people here ain't easily scared.
actually: Local people are not easily frightened.

raw: If this was something normal, we'd deal with it ourselves, but it's pretty obvious it ain't.
actually: We would handle an ordinary problem ourselves, but this is unusual.

raw: This is exactly the sort of assignment we're here for.
actually: This is the kind of task we handle.

raw: If you can understand me, you can't stay near a village where there are people you can hurt.
actually: If you understand me, you must leave the village to avoid harming people.

raw: Apologies, but we'll have to relocate you to an enclosed area until I'm able to find a way to return you to where you came.
actually: We must contain you until we can return you to your origin.

raw: Okay, I'll tire it out, then you capture it, then you'll buy me dinner.
actually: I will exhaust it, you will capture it, and then buy me dinner.

raw: What did you do to her?
actually: What have you done to her?

raw: On a chance that you can understand me, I'll tell you this.
actually: I will say this in case you understand me.

raw: If you don't return my friend now, you'll regret it.
actually: Return my friend immediately or face consequences.

raw: Shiori, come on. We're supposed to go out today.
actually: Shiori, we planned to go out today.

raw: What if we go to the movies?
actually: Shall we go to a movie?

raw: Shiori. I was hoping to talk to you about this after a fun day out, but I really need to ask you.
actually: Shiori, I intended to ask after our outing, but need to ask now.

raw: Do you still think about what life was like before the cell?
actually: Do you think about life before the cell?

raw: I've come to seek your help, Archiver.
While on a mission for Justice, I encountered a dark and magical beast.
actually: On a Justice mission, I found a dark magical creature.

raw: The locals said that since its arrival, all the animal life has all but completely vanished.
actually: Locals said almost all animals disappeared after it arrived.

raw: It can create a black ink to snatch its prey, and it may have telekinetic abilities.
actually: It captures prey with black ink and may have telekinesis.
It sounds like a mindless void.

raw: Oh, I read about those in one of Shiori's books.
actually: I read about them in Shiori's book.

raw: Um, if I'm remembering it right, they grow in strength and knowledge by pulling living things into their pocket dimension.
actually: I recall that they gain power and knowledge by drawing living beings into a pocket dimension.

raw: Do you mean that what it claims isn't lost?
actually: Are the beings it takes still recoverable?

raw: Once it's captured in enough life force, it'll become a powerful demon by absorbing everything in the pocket dimension.
actually: After collecting sufficient life force, it absorbs everything in its pocket dimension and becomes a powerful demon.

raw: And once that happens, well, anything in there will be gone forever.
actually: Everything inside will then be permanently lost.

raw: Then this beast needs to be stopped at once.
Sorry. If my horn wasn't broken, I could, but nowadays
actually: I could help if my horn were intact, but it is broken.

raw: It's fine. Liz can do it.
Let me know how it goes.
Shiori, I'll require your help to defeat this creature.
actually: Shiori, I need your assistance to defeat it.
I cannot help now because I am occupied.

raw: But Shiori, if I'm remembering what I read right, doesn't that monster's power grow exponentially?
actually: Shiori, does the creature's power not grow exponentially?

raw: If that is so, then tomorrow may be too late.
actually: If so, tomorrow may be too late.

raw: You're the leader of Justice, after all.
Go, go. Less chatting, more fighting.
actually: Go fight instead of continuing to talk.

raw: If it ate GG, then it knows about my existence.
actually: If it absorbed GG, it knows that I exist.
Stop talking; I find that unpleasant.

raw: Liz, you need to keep your distance.
